_why: The statement is the one thing all three archon CLI lanes must print BYTE-IDENTICALLY, and it is the thing the person reads before signing. cli/smoke.mjs pins exactly ONE rendered statement — the store-key login it runs against the server it hosts itself — and this fixture pins every OTHER source line, with no network: each lane's unit suite reads THIS file and asserts its renderer reproduces `statement` exactly. Change the wording here and all three suites fail until all three lanes agree again. `offer_cases` is the same pin for the offers form (docs/login.md §4.1 rule 4): the LEDGER the CLI prints AFTER answering, the same fields the statement shows before signing, with the service's verdict as its last line — and never the code.

_verified: Each lane's pin was PROVEN to fire: perturbing `statement` here fails the Go, Rust and TypeScript suites. A fixture nobody can fail is not a pin, so it was checked rather than assumed.
_go_cache_caveat: This file lives OUTSIDE the cli/go module, so Go's test cache does not treat it as an input: after editing ONLY this file, `go test ./...` can report `ok (cached)` and miss the change. Use `go test -count=1 ./...` when you change the wording. CI is unaffected — it runs on a fresh checkout with no cache. Rust and TypeScript re-read it every run.
